 CISCE releases 2027 datesheet ahead of CBSE clash
 By News Desk 
 Tuesday, 10 November 2026, 18:47:23 IST 
 0 
 Facebook WhatsApp X Telegram 
 The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) has officially announced the 2027 board examination schedules. 
 Exam Schedules and Scale
 CISCE will conduct Class 12 (ISC) exams across 60 subjects from February 9 to April 8, 2027. 
 Over 1.10 lakh students from 1,651 affiliated schools will take these exams at 1,477 domestic and overseas centres. 
 Meanwhile, CISCE will hold Class 10 (ICSE) board exams from February 15 to March 31, 2027. 
 The council has arranged 2,835 examination centres across India and abroad for the Class 10 candidates. 
 Strict Exam Day Timings
 Chief Executive Joseph Emmanuel instructed Class 10 students to take their seats inside exam halls by 9:45 am. 
 Question paper reading time begins at 10:00 am, and students will start writing their answers at 10:15 am. 
 Regional Participation and CBSE Clash
 Uttar Pradesh leads Class 10 participation with 51,168 candidates, followed by West Bengal (46,521) and Karnataka (33,417). 
 Maharashtra (31,035), Punjab (19,308), and Jharkhand (17,201) also contribute high student numbers. 
 Earlier, the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) scheduled its Class 10 and 12 exams starting February 16, 2027. 
 Real-Time Digital Credentials
 The Ministry of Electronics and IT confirmed that ICSE and ISC students can access results instantly via DigiLocker. 
 Students can download their authentic digital mark sheets and certificates anytime and anywhere through this secure Digital India platform.
